items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: him and Jimmy Shirley, they changed their instruments on the record.

ctx.x: Jimmy Shirley. And I can't think of the bass player's name. There's always somebody I can't think of their name. Jimmy Shirley and... Funny thing, he plays bass and guitar, this fellow, because him and Jimmy Shirley, they changed their instruments on the record. I think Jimmy Shirley was hired to play guitar, and the other fellow played guitar and Jimmy played bass. Yeah, they were very accomplished musicians. He had a... I don't know who the piano player... I can't think of his name either. He was a very good…
